We're a small bakery in Portland looking for a shift lead who can open the shop at 5am, manage two bakers and a counter person, handle the register and daily cash reconciliation, and keep us compliant with the county health code. You should have at least a year of food service experience, be comfortable with a POS system, and be able to lift 50 lb sacks of flour. ServSafe certification is a plus. Pay is $22/hr plus tips. Email us if that sounds like you.
